nav.title: IPEDS via NCES College Navigator - CSUF admissions considerations (fall 2024)

test_policy.notes: The CSU system no longer uses SAT/ACT in admission decisions; College Navigator (IPEDS fall 2024 admissions) lists SAT/ACT as 'Not considered (Test Blind)'. Admission uses a Multi Factor Admission Score for U.S. graduates and a 'competitive GPA' for graduates of schools outside the U.S.

requirements.notes: Apply through Cal State Apply; $70 fee. Graduates of schools outside the U.S. need 3 years of mathematics (algebra, geometry, intermediate algebra) and a competitive GPA (no number published); full A-G courses are required only for U.S. high school graduates. Official transcripts with certified translations; passport copy and recent financial documents (under 6 months) are needed for the I-20. Some majors have supplemental requirements. College Navigator shows essays and recommendations are not considered.

deadlines.label: First-year application filing period closes, Cal State Apply (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Cal State Apply opens Aug 1, 2026 and submissions run Oct 1 to Nov 30, 2026. CSUF's international pages say applications open Oct 1 for fall but publish no separate international deadline, so plan for Nov 30, 2026 unless the admissions office confirms a later date.

deadlines.label: Official initial transcripts due (selected students only)
Final deadline for final official transcripts
deadlines.notes: Priority date for final transcripts is July 1, 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: The page says additional options to meet the requirement are available and some countries are exempt, but does not list them. It names no Duolingo, Cambridge or new-scale TOEFL minimum for first-time freshmen.

english.notes: Page says 'TOEFL: 61+'; the new 1-6 scale is not mentioned.

aid.notes: CSUF's international cost page states scholarships are limited and only for CSUF enrolled students. The two international scholarships listed (Minh Tam Nguyen for international undergraduates, GPA 3.0+; Abroova and Prabakar, needs-based) are for currently enrolled students, so no entrance scholarship for new international freshmen was found. No ESL or conditional-admission pathway is described on the pages checked.

cost.notes: CSUF estimate for one academic year (24 units): tuition and fees $18,543, living expenses $24,034, health insurance $1,820 (other), total $44,397. The page does not state the academic year; it is treated as current. No separate books line is given.

tier_notes.general: Very large Orange County public (about 37,000 undergraduates) that receives over 50,000 first-year applications, admits about 87-91%, and has no test requirement; D+ is an editorial judgment, not a ranking.
